recall.question: A 32 cm square tray holds 10 cm discs in a square grid. Each disc is turned 45°. How many fit now?
recall.why: 32 ÷ 10 rounds down to 3 per row, so 3 × 3 = 9 either way: a turned circle takes the same space. 16 would need 8 cm discs.
